seo.metaDescription: Learn how to make the ultimate Classic BLT sandwich with crispy bacon, fresh lettuce, and ripe tomatoes. Get our easy step-by-step recipe for a perfect lunch!

seo.imageCaption: Savor the simple perfection of a homemade Classic BLT sandwich – a timeless American lunch favorite.

description: The Classic BLT sandwich is an iconic American lunch, celebrated for its simple yet perfect combination of crispy bacon, crisp lettuce, and juicy ripe tomatoes. It's a testament to the idea that sometimes the best flavors come from fresh, quality ingredients assembled with care. This timeless favorite offers a satisfying crunch and refreshing taste in every bite.

ingredients.notes: washed and dried, outer leaves removed
good quality, like Hellmann's or Duke's

instructions.title: Cook the Bacon to Perfection
instructions.text: Place bacon slices in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook, turning occasionally, until crispy and golden brown, about 8-12 minutes. Remove bacon from skillet and place on a plate lined with paper towels to drain excess fat. This ensures maximum crispiness.

instructions.title: Prepare the Fresh Produce
instructions.text: While the bacon cooks, wash and thoroughly dry the romaine lettuce leaves. Core the ripe tomatoes and slice them into 1/4-inch thick rounds. Season the tomato slices lightly with salt and freshly ground black pepper. This brings out their natural sweetness.

instructions.title: Toast the Bread
instructions.text: Toast the bread slices to your desired level of golden crispness. You can use a toaster, a toaster oven, or lightly pan-fry them in a clean skillet. The toast provides the perfect structural integrity and a complementary crunch for the BLT.

instructions.title: Spread the Mayonnaise
instructions.text: Once the bread is toasted, generously spread mayonnaise on one side of each slice. This creates a flavorful barrier and adds essential creaminess to the sandwich. Do not skimp on the mayo!

instructions.title: Assemble the BLT
instructions.text: Lay four slices of mayo-coated toast on a clean surface. On each slice, layer a generous amount of lettuce leaves, followed by the seasoned tomato slices. Arrange 3-4 slices of crispy bacon over the tomatoes. Top with the remaining four slices of toast, mayo-side down.

instructions.title: Slice and Serve Immediately
instructions.text: Carefully slice each assembled BLT sandwich in half, either diagonally or straight down the middle. Serve your classic BLT sandwiches immediately with your favorite side, like potato chips or a simple pickle spear. Enjoy the fresh, savory, and crunchy perfection!

tips: For perfectly crispy bacon, start it in a cold skillet over medium-low heat and let the fat render slowly. This renders more fat and results in crispier bacon without burning.
The quality of your ingredients truly shines in a BLT. Use ripe, in-season tomatoes and a good quality, full-fat mayonnaise for the best flavor and texture.
BLTs are best enjoyed immediately after assembly to prevent the toast from getting soggy. If you must prepare ahead, keep ingredients separate and assemble just before serving.
